message.content: During the community meeting held on August 12, 2026, at 11:00 AM, Muradin Bronzebeard suggested that they should plan the layout of the garden well. He proposed grouping the flowers by color or height to achieve a visually appealing effect. Muradin Bronzebeard further suggested adding benches or seating areas to provide a relaxing spot for community members to enjoy the garden. Additionally, he mentioned the importance of maintaining the garden throughout the season and recommended setting up a schedule for watering and maintenance to prevent it from becoming overwhelming for any one person. Li Hua agreed with these points, indicating her readiness to contribute to the discussions and decisions made during the meeting.
